name: Four-Season Snow Globe
description: A giant snow globe containing four seasons in separate glowing quadrants.
prompt: A single magical object image: a giant ornate glass snow globe on a mossy pedestal, inside it four miniature seasons divided into glowing quadrants — spring blossoms, summer beach, autumn forest, winter snow — tiny ecosystems blending at the borders, soft magical light, detailed miniature realism, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: One globe. All four seasons. Zero packing. ❄️🌸☀️🍂
